extName.message: Aplica: save job postings and see your fit

extDescription.message: Save job postings to your Aplica account in one click, check your fit and keep your CV and form answers at hand. Free.

connectFeatureSave.message: Reads the job posting on the page and saves it to your tracker. Saving is free.

connectFeatureFit.message: Tells you in seconds whether you fit, based on your Aplica profile.

connectFeatureApply.message: Gives you your CV and application texts, and helps you fill in the company's form.

connectHint.message: Aplica will open so you can sign in and approve the connection.

connectPrivacyClick.message: It does not read any page until you click the Aplica icon on it.

connectPrivacyTabs.message: It does not see your history or your other tabs.

connectPrivacySubmit.message: It never submits an application for you or spends credits.

connectIntro.message: Save the job posting you are looking at, check whether you fit and keep your application at hand, without leaving the site.

connecting.message: Waiting for you to approve the connection…

noticeRevoked.message: The connection has been closed. Connect again to keep using Aplica.

errorDenied.message: You did not allow the connection.

errorInvalid.message: The connection could not be completed. Please try again.

errorNetwork.message: Could not reach Aplica. Check your connection and try again.

errorRateLimited.message: Too many attempts. Wait a minute and try again.

errorServer.message: Aplica is not responding as expected. Please try again later.

previewIntro.message: Check what Aplica has read from the page. You can correct it before you save. Saving is free.

fieldInvalid.message: This field is not valid. Check it.

noAccessWhere.message: It is this icon, at the top right. If you cannot see it, it is in the extensions menu, the one with the puzzle piece.

noAccessWhy.message: Why: for your privacy, Aplica can only read a page after you click its icon on it, and it loses access as soon as you change page.

noAccessInline.message: It cannot be read again: the extension no longer has access to this page. Click the Aplica icon in the browser toolbar and it will read it automatically.

readFailedTitle.message: The page could not be read

needsSelection.message: Aplica could not find the job posting on this page. Select its text with the mouse and press “Use the selected text”.

noAccess.message: To read this page, click the Aplica icon in the browser toolbar. It also works with the side panel open: it will read the page as soon as you click.

unsupportedPage.message: Open a job posting on a job board or a company website and click the Aplica icon on it.

readFailed.message: The page may not have finished loading. Try again.

noticeTruncated.message: The description was too long and has been shortened to $MAX$ characters.

noticeFromSelection.message: The description is the text you had selected on the page.

errorScope.message: This connection does not allow saving job postings. Disconnect and connect again.

possibleDuplicate.message: You already have a similar application: $TITLE$ at $COMPANY$. It may be the same job posting with a different link.

savedText.message: $TITLE$ at $COMPANY$ is in your account as a saved application.

duplicateTitle.message: You already have this job posting in Aplica

quickFitIntro.message: A quick reading of this job posting against your profile: the key requirements and a provisional verdict. The full fit report, prepared with your application, is the one that counts.

quickFitDisclaimer.message: This is a quick reading. The full fit report, prepared with your application, is the one that counts.

quickFitCreditsRequired.message: You have already used today's free readings. In Aplica you can run this reading with credits (price in credits: $PRICE$), always with your confirmation.

quickFitReportExists.message: This application already has the full fit report, which is the one that counts.

quickFitNoPosting.message: The job posting text is missing. Add it in Aplica to see the fit.

quickFitNoProfile.message: To see the fit you need your career profile in Aplica.

quickFitBusy.message: A reading is already in progress. Wait a few seconds and try again.

quickFitUnavailable.message: Aplica could not check the fit right now. Please try again in a few minutes. You have not used any reading.

quickFitRefused.message: This reading could not be done for this job posting. You have not used any reading.

quickFitFailed.message: The reading could not be completed. Please try again. You have not used any reading.

errorScopeQuickFit.message: This connection does not allow reading your career profile. Disconnect and connect again.

devExportWarning.message: Development only. The file contains personal data and the page's real content: do not share it outside the project.

devExportDone.message: File downloaded. Save it in fixtures-raw/.

devExportError.message: The page could not be exported. Click the Aplica icon on it and try again.

devExportNoAccess.message: The extension no longer has access to this page because you have changed page since you clicked the icon. Click the Aplica icon in the browser toolbar (it also works with the side panel open) and click “Export page” again.

documentsIntro.message: Your documents for this application are one click away. Download or copy them to use in the company's form.

documentsQuestionsTruncated.message: The job posting had more questions than could be answered. Check the form.

question.example: Why do you want to work here?

documentsCopyFailed.message: Could not copy. Select the text and copy it by hand.

documentsNotReady.message: This application does not have its documents prepared yet. Prepare it in Aplica.

documentsReconnectText.message: This connection was made before the panel could show documents. Connect this browser again to see them.

documentsScopeMissing.message: This connection does not allow viewing documents. Connect this browser again.

documentsFormatMissing.message: That format is not available for this application.

documentsDownloadFailed.message: Could not download the file. Please try again.

fillIntro.message: Your Aplica details to copy into any form. On Workday, Greenhouse, Lever, SmartRecruiters, Workable, Teamtailor and Personio, the extension can also fill it in for you. You always submit it yourself.

fillNoData.message: Your Aplica profile has no details to copy yet.

fillNoProfile.message: To fill in forms you need a profile in Aplica.

fillScopeMissing.message: This connection does not allow reading your profile. Connect this browser again.

fillPermissionHint.message: The browser will ask your permission for this site the first time. It is only asked when you press this button.

fillUnsupported.message: This form is not filled in automatically: copy the details from the list.

fillPermissionDenied.message: Without permission for this site it cannot be filled in. You can copy the details from the list.

fillNoAccess.message: The extension does not have access to this page. Click the Aplica icon in the browser toolbar, with the form in front of you, and try again.

fillFailed.message: This page could not be filled in. Please try again.

fillDone.message: Form filled in. Check it before you continue.

fillResultCvHad.message: The CV field already had a file and was left alone.

fillResultCvNoInput.message: No place to attach the CV was found. Upload it yourself.

fillResultCvNotAccepted.message: The CV field does not accept this format. Upload it yourself.

fillResultCvFailed.message: The CV could not be attached. Upload it yourself.

fillResultCvDownload.message: The CV could not be downloaded from Aplica. Please try again.

fillResultHadValue.message: Fields that already had a value and were left alone (in yellow): $COUNT$.

fillResultAskYou.message: Fields you answer yourself, marked in red with “Answer this yourself”: $COUNT$. Visa, salary, gender and other sensitive questions are never filled in.

fillResultUnanswered.message: Open questions with no prepared answer: $COUNT$.

fillResultNothing.message: Nothing to fill in was found on this page. Is it the application form?

fillReviewNote.message: Check what has been filled in, highlighted in green, before you continue. Aplica never submits the form: you do that.

fillMissingNoApplication.message: This job posting has no application in Aplica, so only your contact details were filled in. Prepare the application to attach the CV and fill in the questions.

fillMissingNotReady.message: The application is not prepared yet, so only your contact details were filled in. Prepare it in Aplica to attach the CV and fill in the questions.

fillMissingScope.message: This connection does not allow reading the documents, so only your contact details were filled in. Connect this browser again.

fillMissingDocuments.message: The application documents could not be retrieved, so only your contact details were filled in. Please try again.

fillGenerateQuestions.message: Some open questions have no prepared answer. Generate the answers to the Form questions in Aplica and fill in again.

sentQuestion.message: This page confirms that you have sent your application for $TITLE$ at $COMPANY$.

sentQuestionUnnamed.message: This page confirms that you have sent an application you have in Aplica.

sentQuestionNew.message: This page confirms that you have sent an application that is not in Aplica yet. Check the job title and the company, and we will save it as sent.

sentHint.message: Nothing changes until you press the button. If it had no sent date, it will be today's date.

sentDoneText.message: $TITLE$ at $COMPANY$ is in your account as sent.

sentDoneTextUnnamed.message: The application is in your account as sent.

sentFollowUp.message: We will remind you on $DATE$. You can change the date in the Summary of the application, in Aplica.

sentLaterText.message: In your tracker, this application has already moved past sent, so we have not changed it.

sentDismissedText.message: Fine, we have not changed anything. If you send it later, you can mark it as sent in Aplica.

sentNotFound.message: That application is no longer in your account.
